# Third-party source notice — slot machine lever

BU'D Mini Games uses a simplified, recolored and rescaled adaptation of the vertical slot-machine handle silhouette and pull interaction from the open-source **Mavox-ID/Slot** project. The original source defines the handle base, stem and ball (via the handle pseudo-element), together with drag-and-release motion. Our wheel uses the same model with a keyboard-accessible button and a single pull animation, with the game logic remaining proprietary to BU'D.

Source: https://github.com/Mavox-ID/Slot
Original file: https://github.com/Mavox-ID/Slot/blob/main/index.html
Original license: https://github.com/Mavox-ID/Slot/blob/main/LICENSE
Adaptation: `src/mini-games/MiniGameStage.tsx` and `src/mini-games/mini-games.css`
